name: Shenzhen New Nanshan Holding (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen New Nanshan Holding (Group) Co., Ltd. operates in real estate, warehousing and logistics, industrial park, manufacturing, and other businesses in China. The company is involved in development of residential, industrial, and commercial real estate projects; development and operation of logistics parks; engineering, procurement, and construction; photovoltaic, and wind power generation business; offshore engineering; and offshore and onshore general contracting, including design, procurement, and construction.
